transport.framing: One JSON-RPC 2.0 message per line (UTF-8, LF). At most 64 MB per message.
transport.target: document.* and its parts take "document" (an id; the first positional parameter). Other API objects take "handle".
transport.bytes: Base64 text. A BytePattern also accepts {"hex": "DE AD"} or {"text": "random"}.
